messages:
anna: Heads up — saw a batch of requests in QA routed to an older dedicated pool even though the SA token was rotated. looks like the auth cache returned an old org mapping for ~2m.
lee: Can you paste logs + token id? repro steps?
anna: sure. token prefix: `sa_03a4bf`. logs show auth cache hit but `org_id` = old-org-47. timestamp shows cache lookup at 2024-09-12T15:02:11Z then request routed at 15:04:05Z.
```
# auth lookup
INFO 2024-09-12T15:02:11Z auth.cache GET sa_03a4bf -> hit org=old-org-47 age=189s
INFO 2024-09-12T15:04:05Z router.route request id=xyz org=old-org-47 pool=dedicated-1
ERROR 2024-09-12T15:04:05Z attribution.mismatch expected=new-org-99
```
james: my hunch: cache TTL + key rotation race + fuzzy-routing that picks pools by org tag. If token was minted/rotated and the exchange path updated org mapping, the cache still had old mapping -> wrong pool selection.
tess: We should emit `token_age_seconds` and `auth_cache_age` in telemetry. Right now we only record org_id and token_id. Add a panel for staleness distribution.
sara: UX impact: console shows per-org active model/pool. If backend attribution is stale, the console will report wrong active pool and users get confused. We need fallback in routing + a small UX banner while we roll the fix.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary/sa-auth-cache-ttl-bump -> starting rollout (10% hosts)
lee: What does the mitigation plan look like? immediate fallback? db migration?
anna: Plan proposal: 1) short-term: lower auth cache TTL from 5m -> 60s and emit `auth_cache_age` metric; 2) mid-term: make routing decision consult fresh introspect if `auth_cache_age` > 30s for write-heavy SA paths; 3) telemetry: increase sampling for traces with `auth_cache_age>30s` and surface a Grafana panel + alert. Canary via feature flag `sa-staleness-routing-fix` @ 10% then 50%.
james: Draft PromQL for alerting and panel:
```
# percent of requests with auth_cache_age > 30s in the last 5m
(sum(rate(requests_total{auth_cache_age_seconds_approx=~"[3-9][0-9]"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(requests_total[5m]))) * 100
```
tess: also bump sampling for traces where `auth_cache_age_seconds_approx > 30` so we get full flamegraphs. I'll make a telemetry PR.
sara: I can own the console PR to show a small "routing mismatch" banner when mismatch rate > 2% for an org. will add a dismiss CTA and link to runbook.
anna: I'll open infra PRs: cache TTL change + emit token_age/auth_cache_age, plus canary flag rollout plan. starting tomorrow morning IST. thanks all :thumbsup:
lee: can you add a short test case for rotation->immediate-request in the auth unit tests? saves headaches.
anna: will do — adding test and test vectors to the PR.
anna: tagging this thread with #rollout-plan and will follow up with timestamps once canary starts. :rocket:
